title: BrickBench: Evaluating Agentic Brick Design
abstract: arXiv:2610.12452v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We propose BrickBench, a benchmark for agentic text-conditioned LEGO-set design. Given a prompt, an agent is tasked with producing an assembly that not only satisfies semantic and design criteria, but that can also be physically built. To do so, it must select parts from a discrete library and reason jointly about local and global constraints. We score validity, alignment, and design across three settings that vary in scale and part availability. We provide BrickAgent, an environment for coding agents to construct, inspect, and validate their designs. We find that leading agents largely satisfy verifiable physical and semantic requirements, but fall short of human designs. We release our benchmark and environment at http://www.brickben.ch

translated_title: BrickBench：评估智能体的乐高积木设计能力
translated_abstract: 我们提出了BrickBench，一个用于评估智能体在文本条件下进行乐高套装设计的基准测试。给定一个提示，智能体的任务是产出一个组装方案，该方案不仅要满足语义和设计标准，还必须在物理上能够实际搭建。为此，智能体必须从一个离散的零件库中选取零件，并同时对局部和全局约束进行联合推理。我们在三个规模和零件可用性各不相同的环境设置中，对有效性、一致性和设计质量进行评分。我们还提供了BrickAgent，一个供编码型智能体构建、检查和验证其设计的环境。我们发现，领先的智能体在很大程度上能够满足可验证的物理和语义要求，但其设计水平仍不及人类。我们在 http://www.brickben.ch 上发布了该基准测试和环境。
tldr: 提出了BrickBench基准，用于评估智能体根据文本提示设计可实际搭建的乐高作品的能力，发现现有领先智能体虽能满足物理和语义约束，但设计水平仍不及人类。
en_tdlr: Proposes BrickBench, a benchmark for evaluating agentic text-conditioned LEGO-set design, showing that leading agents largely satisfy verifiable physical and semantic requirements but still fall short of human designs.
